Export Audio and MIDI

  

  
  
Cycles of the jam
    

  
Fade out at the end
    

  
  
Saves to your downloads as 

  

  

  
MP3 is small enough to send; WAV is lossless, and about eight
    times the size — take it when the file is going into a video edit.
    MIDI carries the notes rather than the sound: your pan's real pitches,
    for playing back with any instrument in a music program. It is tiny, it is
    written instantly, and the fade-out does not apply to it.
    MP3 encoding by LAME.

Transitions

    
A row can end with a run of single notes that leads into the next
      chord — the groove stands aside while it plays. Turning Motion on switches
      it on and turning Motion off switches it off; either way this switch decides.

  

  

    
Chord suggestions

    
Mild keeps to plain triads. Hotter lets sevenths, ninths
      and diminished chords in.

  

  





  
Breaks

  

    
Breaks

    
The jam keeps running underneath the silence. Hold your groove
      and come back in with it — the first beat of the break still sounds.

  

  

    
How long, how often

    

  

  

    
During the break

    
The click can keep the time for you, or leave you to it. The
      bass and the drums can carry on so you are playing against a band rather
      than into silence. The marker either walks the silent bars or waits on the
      last beat you heard.

Loop not available

  
Looping is off while the notation is synced to the video — the recording is the clock. Turn Follow video off to loop a bar.

  
  






  
Video sound is on

  
The notation player has been muted, so the two don’t play over each other.

  
  




  
Video sound is off

  
Would you like to hear the notation player instead? It plays the notes on the pan you choose here.

  
  

    




  
Pan sound is on

  
Would you like to mute the video, so the two don’t play over each other?
